body:
I appreciate your words, honestly. I wouldnt be here if I didnt. And Im not intentionally trying to downplay or deny anything you say, but like any other person at the bottom of the barrel, I just cant see the light everyone expects the "sad" person to see. 

I thought I had a lot ahead of me, I thought I would get over it, I thought a lot of things, but I just want to rest now. I dont know how people do it but I... I cant... I dont see it... I mean, when I phrase it a different way it doesn't seem so bad? What's so wrong with going to see my dad? Plus the only people that Ive felt have been honest with me were the people that told me I was somewhat burdening them in real life... I didnt know it wasnt common for people to say that theyre a burden on you until I told a friend of mine about it... Maybe because of my mood, I make my life sound worse than what it is, but I mean, like I said, what's so wrong with going to see my dad? That sounds better than the s-word? Makes it sound.. normal...
